subject: Regional Commit Sprint: week 20 snapshot & asks
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 10:15:00 +0000
Subject: Regional commit sprint — initial request

Hi team / Emma,

Following up on the weekly pipeline hygiene push: we're running a short 'commit sprint' for EMEA/APAC (week 20) to get a clean snapshot for finance and forecasting. Please do the following by EOD Wednesday (May 19):

- Update stage for any active Opps in HubSpot to the most recent seller-verified stage (Proposal, Contracting, Legal, Committed).
- Add a 1-line note on next step date and probability.
- If the deal is blocked by procurement/security, flag it in the notes and CC procurement.

I've attached a simple commit template (commit_template_Q2.xlsx) — use tab "EMEA_APAC" and paste HubSpot deal id + net ARR + stage + next step. I'll collate and hand off to Finance on Thursday morning.

Emma — since Atlas Health is in the regional rollup, can you confirm whether procurement will sign-off this month or push to June? Any ETA you can share helps me set the commit percentage.

Thanks — short and sharp here.

Connor O'Brien
Sales Manager, EMEA / Redwood Inference

Connor / team,

Quick internal guidance for the sprint:

- Suggested commit buckets for AE discretion: Committed=95%, Contracting=70%, Proposal=40%, Demo/Discovery=10%. Use these as a default unless you have explicit PO/LOI.
- For cross-region deals that span APAC + EMEA, mark the region owning the largest dollar value as the regional owner for this rollup.
- If an opp has outstanding security questions (data residency, SOC 2 evidence), mark "Blocked — Security" and list the missing artifacts. CS will follow up.

Ben — can you run the quick query for deals > $50k and share the list by EOD? I'll start populating the snapshot once I have your export.

FYI I fixed a small formula error in the attached commit_template_Q2.xlsx (sheet "EMEA_APAC"). Re-save as EMEA_week20_snapshot.xlsx when you're done.
